name: StreamBridge
subtitle: A media client for Android and iOS. Bring your own catalogs, addons and plugins.
description:
StreamBridge is a media client for Android, with an iOS build starting in 0.1.08. You bring catalogs, addons and plugins; the app does not ship, host or preseed any content.

Built on GPL-3.0-licensed core work with StreamBridge identity, an in-app updater, profiles, ratings, episode shuffle and the CloudStream compatibility runtime. Full attribution and license texts live in the repository.

The iOS build published here is unsigned. AltStore and SideStore sign it with your own Apple ID when installing, which is why no App Store listing exists.

# StreamBridge 0.1.17

## StreamBridge 0.1.17

StreamBridge version 0.1.17 (version code 117). Android package
`com.streambridge.app`; iOS bundle `com.streambridge.app`.

## 🌐 Introducing the Official StreamBridge Website

The official StreamBridge website is now live: [streambridgeapp.pages.dev](https://streambridgeapp.pages.dev).
It gives the project a dedicated home to present StreamBridge and its identity, with direct access to
project information and official resources. The site makes the project easier to discover and its
information easier to reach, with a clearer, more welcoming presentation.

## Complete core synchronization

This release synchronizes the complete applicable 0.6.11-beta upstream source range from
StreamBridge's recorded 0.6.9-beta baseline. The file-level inventory and merge decisions are
recorded in [`SYNC-MANIFEST-0.6.11-beta.md`](SYNC-MANIFEST-0.6.11-beta.md).

## Playback and subtitles

- **Anime4K video enhancement** — optional 2× upscaling and line sharpening for the Android
  ExoPlayer and mpv playback paths, with player controls and device-local settings.
- **Subtitle shadow outline blur** — soften subtitle outlines while retaining sharp glyphs;
  rendering and preferences are supported on Android and iOS.
- Forced-subtitle selection and automatic subtitle synchronization are enabled by default.
  AutoSync can be enabled without choosing a preferred subtitle language.
- Restored subtitle tracks search further for a fit before falling back; MPV playback errors
  now include actionable engine details.
- Android playback startup, buffer limits, caption-setting reads, and network TLS setup failure
  handling were hardened. Existing user sessions are retained when a refresh attempt fails.

## Discovery and tracking

- MDBList episode matching handles differences between addon episode numbering and TMDB
  numbering, and reuses progress/watched lists until a mapping changes.
- The existing profile-aware playback, library, provider, addon/plugin, watch-party and
  tracking flows remain integrated; the sync does not replace StreamBridge's Trakt or
  CloudStream-specific implementations.

## Performance and reliability

- iOS playback reduces memory pressure during long sessions and 4K HDR/Dolby Vision playback;
  MPV surface teardown and parked Picture-in-Picture close handling are safer.
- Backdrop focus calculations and image framing account for image coverage, foreground
  separation, and dense texture. Hero image failures reset reveal state rather than leaving a
  partially revealed backdrop.
- Player service launch and subtitle restore fallbacks were corrected.

## Translations

Japanese, Hebrew, Bulgarian, Greek, French and Vietnamese text updates are included. StreamBridge
branding and the three-part watch-party install invitation are retained in localized strings.

## StreamBridge release identity

The app name, motto, footer attribution, Android application ID, iOS bundle ID, updater/repository
URLs, production signing configuration, unsigned iOS workflow, AltStore/SideStore source format,
Discord and Telegram identity, and the production website are retained. The release contains no
user-interface rebrand to the upstream project.

## Distribution

The production release is expected to contain four production-signed Android APK ABI variants,
one **unsigned** iOS IPA for AltStore/SideStore, and `checksums.sha256`. Branch-CI debug APKs are
not release artifacts. The release workflow verifies the existing production signing configuration
and refuses to substitute a debug APK or signed iOS IPA.

The in-app updater uses the numeric version code; 117 is newer than 116. The sideload source is
updated from the published release workflow after a real unsigned IPA is attached and verified.

# StreamBridge 0.1.16

## StreamBridge 0.1.16

StreamBridge version 0.1.16 (version code 116). Android package
`com.streambridge.app`, iOS bundle `com.streambridge.app`.

## Core baseline sync

This release integrates the complete applicable 0.6.9-beta core tree at source level —
150 upstream commits, 265 changed files (101 added, 161 modified, 3 removed) — while
keeping every StreamBridge-specific implementation, identifier and integration on top of
it. Every changed file was classified against the previous 0.6.7-beta baseline:
untouched files were taken verbatim, files changed on both sides were three-way merged,
and StreamBridge-owned files (versioning, sideload source, signing, release and Telegram
workflows, branding) were never overwritten.

## Player and playback

- **Audio delay** — shift the audio track against the video from the player's audio
  menu, with an option to remember the delay per output device (Android).
- **Audio amplification** — boost quiet sources above 100 % from the audio menu, with
  an option to keep the gain for the next videos (Android).
- **Downmix and centre mix** — mix surround audio down to a chosen channel count with
  the app's software decoder and raise the dialogue channel, with a "maintain original
  volume" switch (Android).
- **Stalled torrent resume** — a torrent stream that was closed mid-way now resumes at
  the stalled frame instead of restarting the download position.
- The automatic engine failover is pinned to the current source so it cannot fire for a
  stream that is no longer playing.
- libmpv load failures are surfaced in the player instead of leaving a black screen.
- Playback keeps running through phone calls and handles audio focus like a video app
  (duck, pause only on a real loss, resume afterwards).
- Surfaces are attached and detached on the libmpv playback thread, which removes a
  class of crashes when leaving the player quickly.
- Playback locks to landscape on tablets; edge swipes are left to the system back
  gesture instead of seeking.
- VC-1 video that previously played audio only is decoded again.
- **Title logo** — optionally show the title's artwork instead of its text in the
  player controls, with text as the fallback and a language fallback chain for the
  artwork.
- The loading screen shows the current download speed.
- New player-interface options hide the glass backgrounds behind the controls and the
  skip back/forward buttons.
- The chapter skip derivation keeps a post-credits scene as a skip target, never as a
  skippable segment of its own.

## Subtitles

- **Outline blur** — a new subtitle appearance control softens only the outline while
  the text stays sharp; rendered natively on iOS, through the text renderer on Android.
- Automatic subtitle sync now handles ASS/SSA add-on subtitles drawn by libass: cues are
  matched by their dialogue, the synced copy is swapped in place, and the sync falls
  back to an SRT/VTT track when no styled track fits. The subtitle the user picked is
  kept through engine switches.
- The bundled libass renderer was updated.

## Skip intro

- Anime-Skip is queried for Kitsu/MAL identifiers even without an IntroDB mapping; the
  most complete entry is chosen for an episode; open-ended segments are dropped and
  AniSkip is preferred when both have data.

## Details, ratings and streams

- **Star ratings** — rate titles and episodes from the details page. Ratings sync with
  Simkl and MDBList, and a new rating-source picker in Tracking settings decides which
  service stores them.
- The cinematic backdrop now shows behind the floating header; buttons and chips on the
  details page and on the streams list are see-through over backdrops; tablet artwork
  fades into the cinematic backdrop; the glass floating header is kept in cinematic
  mode.
- Movie and show details open faster: TMDB enrichment and related-title lookups no
  longer block the first render.
- **Smart hero framing** — cropped backdrops on Home are framed around the image's
  focal region instead of its centre.

## Home, library and search

- Smoother scrolling on Home, shelves and grids: shared card styles, poster prefetch,
  a compose stability configuration and a baseline-profile module.
- The library's cloud search box and the Discover search box are hidden behind a search
  action in their headers.
- Screen header titles are constrained so long names no longer push the actions off
  screen.

## Live TV

- **Guide, Sports and On Demand** sections next to the channel list, with section tabs,
  a collapsible search, recents / favourites / category chips that show their counts,
  and a grid/list toggle for channels.
- Sports events come from the ESPN scoreboard with a fallback when a date range is
  rejected; the section explains why it is empty instead of showing nothing.
- On Demand lists movies and series from Xtream Codes providers.
- Categories matching the query are included in Live TV search results.
- The back-to-top button is gone and the header offset matches the other tabs.

## Tracking

- Private Viewing moved from Player Interface to Tracking.
- WeTrakr shows the watched badge for completed shows and no longer pushes rewatches.
- Simkl related-title requests are signed and Simkl failures are logged.
- Plugin settings pages open again.

## iOS

- Text subtitles are drawn in Picture in Picture and in the mini player.
- Video output presets are applied when the player opens.
- The skip-ahead after Control Centre / Notification Centre is gone.
- The app background stays in place while the player is parked in PiP, and collection
  folders draw under the native navigation bar so Glass UI shows through.
- The temporary HLS playlist is written correctly again, and the loading speed reads
  the libmpv cache speed with the right type.
- Tamil is registered as an app language.

## Translations

- **Tamil** is a new locale on Android and iOS.
- Bengali, Vietnamese and Bahasa Indonesia were brought up to date with the English
  strings; French gained the audio downmix, amplification and delay strings; two pt-BR
  descriptions were corrected.
- Every new or updated locale file carries StreamBridge branding, and the watch-party
  invitation in the new locales includes the StreamBridge install fallback like every
  other locale.

## Toolchain

- Deprecated Ktor and Kotlin APIs were cleared; `-Xexpect-actual-classes` and the Coil
  experimental opt-in are declared once in the build; a baseline-profile module and
  the profile installer are wired for release builds.

## StreamBridge specifics

- App identity, package `com.streambridge.app`, launcher icon, splash, in-app updater
  (`sascio/MyBridge`), About Us, Licenses & Attributions, CloudStream runtime, Telegram
  release automation and the sideload source are unchanged.
- The upstream sideload-source and Xcode version files were not imported; StreamBridge
  keeps its own.

## Installation

APKs built by branch CI are debug-signed compile artifacts, not production builds. The
published release carries one production APK per ABI (production-certificate signed,
SHA-256 checksums attached as `checksums.sha256`) and an **unsigned** iOS IPA for
AltStore/SideStore re-signing. Install only assets downloaded from this repository's
published releases.

The in-app updater compares version codes, so 0.1.16 (code 116) is offered as an update
over any earlier version.

### iOS installation

The iOS build in this release is **unsigned**. Install it with
[AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [SideStore](https://sidestore.io): either signs the IPA with
your own Apple ID on your device, so no Apple Developer account and no App Store listing is
involved.

Add this repository as a source in AltStore or SideStore to get updates automatically:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sascio/MyBridge/main/store.json`

See `docs/RELEASE-IOS.md` for the details.

# StreamBridge 0.1.15

## StreamBridge 0.1.15

StreamBridge version 0.1.15 (version code 115). Android package
`com.streambridge.app`, iOS bundle `com.streambridge.app`.

## Complete core baseline sync

This release integrates the complete applicable 0.6.7-beta core tree at source level —
96 upstream commits across the whole changed file set — while keeping every
StreamBridge-specific implementation, identifier and integration on top of it. The sync
manifest classified every changed file; conflict-prone files were three-way merged so
neither side's functionality was dropped.

## Appearance

- **Glass UI (experimental)** — a new appearance preset family with dark, balanced and
  vivid presets. Headers render edge-to-edge with a frosted finish on phones and pin at
  the very top of the screen; the full extended header band is dimmed so headers no
  longer look boxed; secondary and muted text stay readable over the app background.
- **App-wide background** — choose an image from your gallery or a URL and it is drawn
  once behind every screen. The dynamic-background and catalog-accent settings moved to
  Layout > Home.
- **Search and library** — both draw one continuous header band with the cloud toolbar
  pinned, and Search keeps Discover in its fixed header band.

## Player and playback

- The video can be resized beside the watch-party panel.
- The automatic source failover only re-arms on a real source change, so it no longer
  loops.
- Anime engine selection is fixed together with the auto-failover loop.
- The skip button keeps its timer continuity through segment-category changes.
- Reusing the last link keeps the chosen stream info and the current-stream marker.

## Subtitles and audio

- Addon-delivered ASS subtitles render through libass on Android again.
- Subtitle addon requests carry file extras and build correct request URLs.
- Local and P2P streams compute OpenSubtitles-compatible hashes for subtitle extras, in
  parity with the TV client.

## Continue watching

- Mark an item as watched directly from its long-press menu.

## Live TV

- The Live TV screen pins its title, search and filter header, and the last-watched card
  is gone.

## iOS

- Playback declares the long-form-video audio session, so the system no longer treats
  it as music playback.
- MPVKit was updated for the host audio session.
- Now Playing publishes only on real playback changes.
- The profile-insight photo picker opens after the native sheet closes, and the insight
  hero and cards render frosted over the app background.

## Translations

Arabic, Bulgarian, Greek, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese,
Turkish and Vietnamese locales were completed and harmonized.

## Toolchain

Gradle 9.8.2, the Android Gradle Plugin 9.4.0 line and compile SDK 37.1.

## StreamBridge specifics

- The About Us entry regained its original icon and subtitle, restored verbatim from
  the original root-page row.
- About Us gained a "Join our Discord" invitation row next to the Telegram community
  channel, opening the invitation in the system browser.
- **Branding fixes (corrective):** About, About Us and Licenses now use three distinct icons (Info, Groups, Description); Telegram now shows its authentic plane logo and Discord its correct Clyde logo with proper proportions; Android notifications now show the StreamBridge B-mark monochrome icon instead of the old Nuvio icon.

|---|---:|---:|
| `androidApp-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | 52.15 MiB | 52.45 MiB |
| `androidApp-full-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | 50.35 MiB | 50.66 MiB |
| `androidApp-full-x86-release.apk` | 52.57 MiB | 52.88 MiB |
| `androidApp-full-x86_64-release.apk` | 53.58 MiB | 53.88 MiB |
| `StreamBridge-0.1.15-iOS-unsigned.ipa` | 69.72 MiB | 70.21 MiB |

Sizes are filled in from the production build jobs before publication.

## Installation

APKs built by branch CI are debug-signed compile artifacts, not production builds. The
published release carries one production APK per ABI (production-certificate signed,
SHA-256 checksums attached) and an **unsigned** iOS IPA for AltStore/SideStore
re-signing. Install only assets downloaded from this repository's published releases.

The in-app updater compares version codes, so 0.1.15 (code 115) is offered as an update
over any earlier version.

**Same-version note:** The initial 0.1.15 (115) was already distributed. A device already on 115 cannot upgrade in-place to this corrected 115 APK (Android requires a higher versionCode). Verify the corrected build with a **clean install** (uninstall existing 0.1.15, then install the new APK for your ABI). New installs and upgrades from any earlier version (e.g., 0.1.14/114) work normally.

### iOS installation

The iOS build in this release is **unsigned**. Install it with
[AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [SideStore](https://sidestore.io): either signs the IPA with
your own Apple ID on your device, so no Apple Developer account and no App Store listing is
involved.

Add this repository as a source in AltStore or SideStore to get updates automatically:

# StreamBridge 0.1.14

## StreamBridge 0.1.14

StreamBridge version 0.1.14 (version code 114). Android package
`com.streambridge.app`, iOS bundle `com.streambridge.app`.

## Hero Section — stability and richer information

The home hero has been rebuilt on the stable page model the reference
implementation uses, fixing the vertical wobble that appeared when the
displayed title changed:

- **Prefetch before the swipe** — while the carousel rests on a title, the
  neighbours' artwork, logo and details are resolved into the in-app caches.
  The incoming title therefore composes with its complete, final-height
  content on the first frame instead of growing after it becomes visible.
- **Draw-time transitions** — artwork and content layers read the live pager
  position at draw time. Content crossfades at the swipe midpoint with no
  partial-opacity blend, artwork layers never dip mid-transition, and layers
  are no longer reordered during a swipe.
- **Stable active item** — the trailer, artwork callback and action row now
  track the settled page directly, so a swipe can no longer restart them
  mid-transition.

The hero also renders the full metadata the app already had: title, content
type, genre, runtime, release date, IMDb rating, age rating / certification
and playing status, language, MDBList / TMDB external ratings when configured,
and the description. Values a catalog preview omits are filled from the app's
metadata cache — nothing is fabricated, no empty labels are shown, and long
titles and synopses ellipsize. Playback actions, the library toggle, trailer
playback and scrolling behaviour are unchanged.

## Corrections in this rebuild

This release was rebuilt in place (same version, same version code) to correct
regressions found in the first 0.1.14 build. The corrected assets replace the
original ones under the same names; see the asset table below.

- **About Us heading** — the About page heading briefly read
  "Supporters & Contributors". It is `About Us` again everywhere the page is
  reached (the Settings About row, settings search, and the page header). The
  page's content — description cards, credits, community links — is unchanged.
- **Footer** — the tagline that had been added to the settings footer is
  removed, and the logo + app name are centred with the text lines they were
  offset from. The footer is the StreamBridge lockup, `Made with ❤️ by Saif`,
  and the version line at the bottom, using the build's real version
  configuration.
- **Branding** — remaining third-party product strings in translated and
  English resources now say StreamBridge: library/progress source pickers
  (StreamBridge Library, StreamBridge Sync), Discord Rich Presence, the
  Picture-in-Picture notice, AniList/WeTrakr approval copy, settings-backup
  copy, P2P consent text, notification, updater and addon-store copy, and the
  TMDB/IMDb/Trakt/Simkl/MDBList/TorBox/Premiumize/IntroDB attribution bodies
  (which correctly name StreamBridge as the app using those services).
  Licence attributions, the privacy policy's backend disclosures and the
  media-server host keep their required references.
- **Size** — five resource files that no code referenced were removed
  (`app_logo_wordmark.png`, `compose-multiplatform.xml`, `sidebar_home.xml`,
  `sidebar_settings.xml`, `trailer_play_button.svg`). Release APKs are
  unaffected by this cleanup (resource shrinking already stripped them); it
  trims the source tree and debug builds. No dependency, codec, provider or
  platform support was touched: with shrinking, per-ABI splits and compressed
  native libraries already in place, every remaining byte is a working feature.

## What is new in 0.1.14

- **Subtitles** — libass atlas rendering for styled ASS/SSA tracks, a subtitle
  appearance page (font, size in 1 sp steps, weight, outline, shadow,
  background, margins) with preview, custom font import, and subtitle styling
  that survives track changes and pause/resume.
- **Chapters and skipping** — chapter panel, Matroska chapter parsing, merged
  and overlapping skip intervals, a setting for when Skip Intro appears, and
  auto-skip on resolved HLS and P2P streams.
- **Night mode** — libmpv audio night mode (dialogue lift + peak limiting) on
  both playback engines, with a player button and a settings entry.
- **Settings** — regrouped root (You / Look / Watch / Services / System) and
  dedicated playback sub-pages; configuration backup and restore.
- **Player and library polish** — single-decimal IMDb ratings, unreleased
  episode labelling, app-icon persistence, player badge codec detection from
  filenames, offline improvements, TV parity for the engine switch.
- **Native modules** — a Rust module builds `libaiostreams_native.so` for
  `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86` and `x86_64` (seek-bar thumbnails,
  container indexes).
- **Media stack** — playback engine 0.1.6 (the iOS engine download is pinned
  to the same version and checksum), a bundled ASS renderer for libass
  subtitles, and current Compose Multiplatform / Material3 / Navigation3.

## StreamBridge-specific behaviour

- Package `com.streambridge.app`, app name StreamBridge, launcher icon, splash,
  updater configuration, signing setup, store JSON and release workflows.
- Watch Party invites: `streambridge://party/<code>` generated from the
  normalized party code, StreamBridge-branded invitation text in every locale,
  an install fallback for recipients without the app, and a repository-hosted
  HTTPS redirect page. Legacy invite link formats are still parsed so links
  shared by earlier builds keep working.
- The privacy policy is an in-app page.
- CloudStream (`.cs3`) extension manager page, in-app updater, profiles,
  licenses and attributions pages.
- The legacy third-party party-invite intent filter no longer claims
  `autoVerify` for a domain StreamBridge does not own. Legacy invites are
  still parsed.

## Fixes in this release

- Credit rolls longer than four minutes can be skipped again: the chapter skip
  derivation only capped openings/recaps at four minutes, so a film's
  "Credits" chapter (routinely 5-8 minutes) never produced a skip.
- The iOS build no longer depends on an unreleased iOS SDK: this build keeps
  the plain safe-area layout (no behaviour change on any iOS version the app
  supports).
- The watch-party invite no longer asks Android to App-Link-verify a domain
  StreamBridge does not own. Legacy invite links are still parsed.
- Branding: the Face ID and local-network iOS permission prompts, the About
  footer and four newly added locales now say StreamBridge.
- Stable hero section: content changes no longer move the hero vertically
  (see the Hero Section section above).

## Branding

Every legacy third-party branding match in user-facing resources was audited,
replaced with StreamBridge branding, or kept where a licence, a backend
disclosure or a compatibility statement requires it. The classification is
recorded in [BRANDING-AUDIT-0.1.14.md](BRANDING-AUDIT-0.1.14.md).

## Download sizes

| Asset | previous release | 0.1.14 corrected build |
|---|---:|---:|
| `androidApp-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | 50.33 MiB | measured below |
| `androidApp-full-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | 48.68 MiB | measured below |
| `androidApp-full-x86-release.apk` | 50.76 MiB | measured below |
| `androidApp-full-x86_64-release.apk` | 51.63 MiB | measured below |
| `StreamBridge-0.1.14-iOS-unsigned.ipa` | 69.66 MiB | measured below |

The Android growth over the previous release is the native module this
release adds (Rust thumbnails and container indexes, software decoder,
libass); no provider, codec, player integration or platform was dropped to
compensate.

## Verification

Static checks and builds run in the repository's own CI (unit tests, Android
lint, full/playstore flavour boundary checks, CloudStream runtime verification,
production signing verification, iOS IPA). See the release notes on the GitHub
release for the artefacts that were actually produced.

### Same-version updater note

This corrected build keeps version code 114, exactly like the first 0.1.14
build. An installed 0.1.14 therefore does not see this rebuild as an update:
version-code comparison only moves upward. Install the corrected APK for your
device ABI directly from this release to pick the fixes up. New installs and
installs of any earlier version update normally. The version was deliberately
not bumped to work around this, per the release decision for 0.1.14.

### iOS installation

The iOS build in this release is **unsigned**. Install it with
[AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [SideStore](https://sidestore.io): either signs the IPA with
your own Apple ID on your device, so no Apple Developer account and no App Store listing is
involved.

Add this repository as a source in AltStore or SideStore to get updates automatically:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sascio/MyBridge/main/store.json`

See `docs/RELEASE-IOS.md` for the details.

## StreamBridge 0.1.08

### Highlights
- Core updated to the 0.5.5-beta core baseline.
- iOS is available for the first time, published as an unsigned IPA for AltStore and SideStore.
- Much smaller downloads: brand assets now ship at the size the interface renders them at.
- New languages: Bengali and Urdu.
- Preserved StreamBridge branding, updater, privacy page, addons, profiles and CloudStream runtime.

### New
- In-app ratings synced with Trakt, Simkl and MDBList, plus a ratings sheet and a star row on details.
- Episode shuffle for series, with its own sheet and per-profile storage.
- Subtitle sync by ear, to align a subtitle track while watching.
- Plugin runtime: async timers and setTimeout support for Nuvio-compatible plugins.
- Downloads entry point moved into the library, with an animated downloads icon.
- Settings: Clear Metadata Cache, and an always-backdrop landscape logo option.

### Improved
- Restyled bottom sheets, dropdown menus and dialogs on the shared UI components.
- Streams screen: shimmer loading states, swipe-to-seek preview and custom landscape posters.
- Debrid: requested episode file selection and a release-aware file selector.
- MDBList: newest library additions first, response value fixes and a rating provider.
- Profile Insight: cached title facts, background stat computation and manual refresh.
- iOS: QuickJS 1.0.15 and a Now Playing audio-session fix.
- Release infrastructure: production APKs and the unsigned iOS IPA build together, and the sideload source is regenerated from every published release.

### Fixed
- iOS: the Kotlin/Native link step now gets the heap it needs, so release IPA builds complete reliably.
- iOS: the CI toolchain probe can no longer fail intermittently.

### Downloads
- Android: pick the APK for the architecture of your device. In-place updates keep working with the production certificate used by 0.1.07.
- iOS: the IPA is unsigned and is not distributed through the App Store. See the installation note below.
- The brand assets were re-encoded to their display size, which makes the iOS IPA about 29 percent smaller and the Android release APKs about 21 percent smaller than before this release.
